findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Ensure 1e63 (vartmp/container resolution) and 0bdf (docker/journald install path) land with or before the accumulator children so the observability probe can resolve every *_CAP_SH it references on a repository-built host.
evidence: 1e63: 'observability.sh resolves the two newest cap scripts as siblings of the RUNNING probe, using their REPOSITORY basename ... Nothing ever creates those two paths ... the name the probe looks for and the name the installer writes can never be the same file.'
0bdf: 'No path in the repository ever writes those two files ... a host built only from repository steps' lacks docker-storage-cap.sh / journald-cap.sh at the probe's sibling path.
S2/S3/S4/S5 roster criteria assert the probe 'publishes ... only on a successful measurement' — which silently yields no metric when the cap script cannot be resolved, so the failure is invisible.
0bdf notes autodeploy.sh:259 OBS_PATHS covers only observability.sh + install-observability.sh, so a cap-script-only change reaches no host.
findings.finding: Cross-child dependency gap: the accumulator children (S2/9183, S3/e956, S4/2ba3, S5/910b) all extend observability.sh to execute per-cap scripts, but the probe resolves those cap scripts by a name that no repository install path writes to /usr/local/bin — so the cap-compliance percentages the accumulator children publish silently go off the air on any repository-built host. Children 1e63 and 0bdf document exactly this coupling for the two cap-script pairs (vartmp/container and docker/journald respectively).
findings.location: child 1e63-bee1-5ce6-4d8f and child 0bdf-b496-7201-4c84 (consumer/dependency coupling to S2-S5's observability.sh probe)
scenarios: A fresh AMI/host rebuild from repository steps alone: docker_storage_used_percent, docker_buildkit_cache_used_percent, journal_used_percent (0bdf) and var_tmp_used_percent, container_writable_used_percent plus both heartbeats (1e63) never publish, and the corresponding breaching alarms sit on missing data or read a false 0.
An accumulator child's cap is genuinely saturated but its per-generator alarm cannot see the metric — the exact 'name the saturated generator' guarantee AC3 promises fails.
findings.suggested_fix: Confirm an ordering/dependency edge so 0bdf's repo-path install and 1e63's candidate-list resolution precede or accompany S2-S5 going into service, and that autodeploy OBS_PATHS is extended to re-materialize the cap scripts alongside the probe.
